prompts.hero_nusantara: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: final mobile app hero background for JelajahNusa, a cultural learning app for Indonesian students. Use the attached reference image only as a style reference, not an edit target: soft scenic travel illustrations, airy sage foliage, peaceful misty landscape. Generate one original wide landscape illustration, 1536x1024 if possible. Layered green Indonesian volcanic mountains, calm tropical lake, distant tiny wooden canoe, soft terraced hills, coconut fronds and lush local foliage toward lower corners. Warm ivory mist across upper left 45% with generous uncluttered negative space to place a large headline later. Main landscape and little lakeside Balinese meru silhouette concentrated in lower right. Restrained sage, eucalyptus, forest green, muted dusty blue, parchment ivory. Beautiful sophisticated hand-painted editorial travel art with fine soft grain, nuanced depth, contemporary minimal composition suitable for premium app. No text, no typography, no UI, no buttons, no device frame, no watermark. This illustration is atmospheric decorative art, not a documentary representation of a real specific place.
